含量区间为论文分位得分口径下的相对量：以该化合物在 250 款样本中的基准浓度为 100%，按风格感官画像与化合物—感官敏感度换算，区间取基准的 ±20%～±30%。论文未逐格公布 226 项指标在 22 个风格上的实测浓度，绝对值仅用于量级对照；论文直接给出的 d 值、位移与阈值均按原文标注。
column2: Content ranges are relative values on the paper's quantile-score scale: 100% is the compound's baseline concentration across 250 samples, converted through the style's sensory profile and the compound–sensory sensitivity, with each range spanning ±20% to ±30% of baseline. The paper does not publish measured concentrations for all 226 indicators across the 22 styles, so absolute values serve only as order-of-magnitude reference. Where the paper states d values, displacements or thresholds directly, they are quoted verbatim.

column1: 本页是论文结论的可视化与推演，不是实测数据库。感官画像为 0–6 相对分级，跨风格比较可比、绝对值不可外推；迁移清单给出方向与量级，工艺放大前仍需以实测浓度复核。论文自身亦声明：dms 与 diacetyl 两个维度的标签与化学测量脱节，其名义化合物与评分的秩相关仅 0.09 与 −0.10。
column2: This page visualises and extrapolates the paper's conclusions; it is not a measured database. Sensory profiles are a 0–6 relative scale — comparable across styles, but absolute values should not be extrapolated. The transfer list gives direction and magnitude; confirm against measured concentrations before scaling a brew. The paper itself notes that the dms and diacetyl dimensions drift from their chemical measurements, with rank correlations of only 0.09 and −0.10.

column1: Pils/Lager → Tripel 的位移为 11.74 个欧氏单位，226 个化合物中 93 个 |Δz| > 0.5、216 个有非零位移；把缺陷约束内嵌后位移只增加 1.3%，判别概率由 0.384 微降至 0.364。表 14 给出 11 个供体的平均前 6 位。
column2: The Pils/Lager → Tripel displacement is 11.74 Euclidean units: of 226 compounds, 93 have |Δz| > 0.5 and 216 move at all. Embedding the defect constraint adds only 1.3% to the displacement, while classification probability slips from 0.384 to 0.364. Table 14 gives the top six averaged over 11 donors.

column1: λ 由 0 增至 0.30 时，非零位移化合物由 216 降到 150、|Δz| > 0.5 的由 93 降到 72，位移只增加 1.8%（11.74 → 11.96），且仍全部达到目标水平。如果要把方案交给酿造端执行，这条路径比全谱调整更可操作。
column2: Raising λ from 0 to 0.30 cuts moving compounds from 216 to 150 and those with |Δz| > 0.5 from 93 to 72, while displacement grows by only 1.8% (11.74 → 11.96) and every target level is still reached. If the plan is to be handed to a brewery, this path is far more workable than adjusting the full profile.

column1: 名单按“先以入选频率 π ≥ 0.6 筛稳定候选、再按边际效应量 |ρ| 排序”的两步规则生成；† 表示候选不足时放宽阈值的补充项。证据等级：一级 17 维可归因到单一化合物，二级 18 维由多化合物共同承载，三级 15 维受标签侧限制。
column2: The list follows a two-step rule: keep stable candidates with inclusion frequency π ≥ 0.6, then rank by marginal effect |ρ|; † marks additions where the threshold had to be relaxed. Evidence tiers: tier 1 covers 17 dimensions attributable to a single compound, tier 2 has 18 shared by several, tier 3 has 15 limited by the label side.

column1: 描述由「化合物 → 感官轴 → 句式」三层规则拼装：先按重要性、含量位置与感官强度计算权重，再取香气类权重最高的三种化合物生成前段，中段读取苦味、酒体、酒精与酸度的聚合分值，尾段选择余味最长的化合物。字数控制在 100–200 之间。
column2: The text is assembled from three layers — compound → sensory axis → sentence pattern. Weights combine importance, where the compound sits in its range, and sensory strength: the top three aroma compounds form the opening clause, the middle clause reads the aggregated scores for bitterness, body, alcohol and acidity, and the closing clause takes the compound with the longest finish. Length is held between 100 and 200 characters.

column1: 「相对基准」是该化合物在本风格中的中位含量相对 250 款样本基准的偏离，▲ 表示高于基准、▼ 表示低于基准；感官贡献取论文中该化合物与各感官维度的关联方向与强度。点「在化合物台打开」可把这组化合物带进交互台继续增减。
column2: “Relative baseline” is how far this compound's median in this style departs from the 250-sample baseline; ▲ means above, ▼ below. Sensory contribution uses the direction and strength of association the paper reports for that compound. “Open in compound lab” carries this set into the interactive bench.

column1: 真实留出样本的 22 类判别召回率为 0.523，生成样本的风格保真 0.766 高于它，说明生成谱偏“典型”；检出率偏差仍有 0.105，保原子机制只减轻、未消除离散检出结构的误差。这些限定同样适用于本页的画像展示。
column2: Recall on the 22 held-out classes is 0.523, while generated samples reach a style fidelity of 0.766 — higher, meaning generated profiles lean “typical”. The detection-rate gap is still 0.105: the atom-preserving mechanism reduces but does not remove the error from the discrete detection structure. The same caveats apply to the profiles shown on this page.

column1: 缺陷约束在每一段都已生效：DMS、双乙酰、4VG、反式-2-壬烯醛沿路径单调不增。整条路径的终点位移为 11.74，判别概率 0.364；若不施加缺陷约束，位移可降到 11.59，也就是说约束的代价只有 1.3%。
column2: The defect constraint holds in every segment: DMS, diacetyl, 4VG and trans-2-nonenal never increase along the path. The end point sits at 11.74 with classification probability 0.364; without the constraint it would fall to 11.59 — the constraint costs only 1.3%.

column1: 区间是该化合物在源/目标风格中的 10%–90% 分布近似；「变化」按中位含量计算。新增表示源风格接近未检出、目标风格明确存在；删减反之。清单按「位移 × 化合物重要性」排序，仅显示前 16 项，共 50 项。
column2: Ranges approximate the 10th–90th percentile of that compound in the source and target styles; “change” uses the median. “Add” means the compound sits near the detection limit in the source and is clearly present in the target; “remove” is the reverse. The list ranks by displacement × compound importance and shows the top 16 of 50.

column1: 前 10 位中有 8 个是酵母代谢产物、1 个来自酒花（里那醇）、1 个来自野生菌群（乳酸）。按来源汇总，位移的 49.0% 落在酵母代谢物、26.1% 落在酒花萜烯——这正是把一款拉格改造成三料应有的动作。
column2: Eight of the top ten are yeast metabolites, one comes from hops (linalool) and one from wild flora (lactic acid). Summed by origin, 49.0% of the displacement falls on yeast metabolites and 26.1% on hop terpenes — exactly the move a lager-to-tripel conversion should make.

column1: 论文仅对 Tripel、Kriek、Lambic、Pils/Lager 四个风格给出指纹表。此处按同一 Cohen's d 定义，在各化合物上跨 22 个风格做标准化后取正负两端，可与其他风格横向比较。
column2: The paper provides fingerprint tables for only four styles — Tripel, Kriek, Lambic and Pils/Lager. Here the same Cohen's d definition is standardised across all 22 styles per compound, then both tails are taken, so other styles can be compared on the same footing.

column1: 轴长 9.27 为两风格质心在 226 维空间中的距离；所需位移 11.57 是把源样本推到目标中位所需的欧氏移动量，与风格内部离散度（均方根约 12）同一量级——跨风格改造更接近重写而非微调。
column2: The axis length of 9.27 is the distance between the two centroids in 226-dimensional space; the required displacement of 11.57 is the Euclidean move that pushes the source to the target median, the same order as the within-style spread (root mean square about 12) — a cross-style change is closer to a rewrite than a tweak.

column1: 18–22 °C 高温发酵，高发酵度酵母将糖迅速转成乙醇与酯。乙酸酯与脂肪酸乙酯同步上升，构成三料最容易被认出的果香。
